title: Quest-based upgrades and Mastery system (replaces buyable upgrades)
description: Replace the coin-buying upgrade system with two new systems: (1) Quest-based upgrades - players complete quests like 'Destroy 2500 destructibles' to unlock upgrades like 'Strong Pets'. (2) Mastery system - XP/level-ups grant mastery points that can be spent on buffs (more coins, better luck, faster pets, etc.) in a Mastery tab.
steps: Create QuestData.lua shared module with quest definitions (destroy X destructibles, hatch X eggs, etc.)
Create MasteryData.lua shared module with mastery buff definitions (more coins, luck, speed, etc.)
Add quest progress and mastery points to DataService default data schema
Replace UpgradeService with QuestService that tracks quest progress and unlocks upgrades on completion
Create MasteryService for spending mastery points on buffs
Update ZoneService to track destructible kills for quest progress
Update Main.server.lua to register QuestService and MasteryService, add remotes
Update UIController to replace Upgrades window with Quests tab and add Mastery tab
Update Main.client.lua to handle quest/mastery remote events
Update Config.lua to reference quest-based upgrades instead of buyable ones
acceptance_criteria: Upgrades are no longer purchasable with coins
Each upgrade is unlocked by completing a specific quest (e.g. destroy 2500 destructibles for Strong Pets)
Quest progress is tracked and displayed in a Quests UI tab
Level-ups award mastery points instead of being cosmetic
Mastery tab shows available buffs that can be purchased with mastery points
Mastery buffs include: more coins per drop, better egg luck, faster pets
UpgradeService.getUpgradeBonus still works for existing bonus lookups (backward compat)
